reviews.comment: Love Dr. Farnell!! Just make sure not to get behind on material and you'll be ok! She's super sweet!

Dr. Farnell is the best! She makes her expectations very clear at the beginning of the course. Quizzes are super easy, exams are easy, and lab exams are easy as well. As long as you study, you will do good. Love Dr. Farnell!!!

Dr. Farnell is the best! Show up to class and do the reviews and you will be fine. Lab ties in well with the lectures and provides hands on aspects to the course. She is great at presenting lectures and is super funny.

Dr. Farnell is an amazing professor. If you work hard and ask her questions she is super willing to help you out and make sure you understand the material. Don't skip any classes or labs or it is too difficult to catch up and understand the material.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She had clear expectations and objectives and stuck to them with a master bank of quiz questions you could fill out as you went. Lab tied into the lecture really well, but both are very passable (and even enjoyable!). Her accent takes some time to get used to and when she gets excited it can be hard to understand her, but she's got a lot to offer!

The class honestly was not that hard, she gave clear expectations and questions from the beginning of the semester as to what to study from each lecture. But it was SO MUCH information. You needed to have started studying for like two weeks before each test. Definitely do not wait till the last minute!! That being said, she gave lots of bonus pts.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough
